newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover plunged to 2.489 billion yuan from 6.903 billion yuan, with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said renewed market rumours that the central bank might cut bank interest rates and bank reserve ratios in the near future depressed the market sentiment.
Central bank officials have declined to comment.
Both the head offices of major state banks and short-term financial centres, or money brokerages run by the central bank, traded less on the first-tier market on Thursday, traders said.
"The rumours will exert downward pressure on the interbank rates in the short term, in particular those for late-maturing contracts," one trader said.
